definitions.gloss: anaerobic; able to live without oxygen
definitions.explanation: The property of being able to live or function without oxygen. Used especially of bacteria and other microorganisms.

examples.japanese: {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}で、⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧。
examples.english: This microbe is anaerobic and prefers environments without oxygen.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}⟦{発酵|はっこう}→発酵：13605_hakkou⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、メタンガス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Fermenting food waste anaerobically produces methane gas.

notes:
Composed of {嫌気|けんき} (disliking air or oxygen) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (-ness, property). A biology and environmental-science term. Often used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧: anaerobic bacteria
- {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}⟦{発酵|はっこう}→発酵：13605_hakkou⟧: anaerobic fermentation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好気|こうき}{性|せい}→好気性：29785_koukisei⟧: aerobic — the antonym; describes organisms that require oxygen to live
